name: IntegrateIT UniFi NVR HDMI
notes: Display-only Control4 AV source for the Ubiquiti UniFi NVR G2 HDMI live-view output. Exposes an HDMI OUT binding so the NVR feed can be routed through an AV matrix and selected in Watch. Controls nothing and reports nothing by design; the binding is the whole point. 3.1.0 shipped an ONSCREEN_SELECTION room binding as a live experiment; installed on real hardware, Composer never offered this device in a room's On-Screen Device list, so 3.2.0 retires it — the documented precondition (the room must also be able to select the device as its video endpoint) is one a source feeding a matrix can never meet. Field-proven routing video on an AVPro Edge matrix; factory build adds self-update, validation, tests, and packaged docs the hand-built v1-v3 never had.
